page_experience.title: The Experience
page_experience.subtitle: More than just a journey, a moment of grace out of time.
page_experience.intro: From the moment you step into our vehicles, the outside world fades away. We designed SELY Privé not as a simple transport service, but as a creator of space and time. A cocoon of elegance where every detail is tailored to awaken your senses and offer you what is most precious: the present moment.
page_experience.b1_desc: Let yourself be carried away without constraints. Your time is yours, we take care of every logistical detail to offer you a total escape.
page_experience.b2_desc: From booking to your return, our service guarantees absolute fluidity. Rely on flawless logistical expertise.
page_experience.b3_desc: Access the inaccessible. We open the doors of the most confidential estates for privileged encounters.
page_experience.b4_desc: Every journey is designed to create an emotion. It is not just a trip, it is the prelude to your most beautiful memories.

page_voyages.title: Our Journeys
page_voyages.subtitle: Four ways to rediscover the art of travel.
page_voyages.v1_desc: Book a private chauffeur for the duration of your choice. He remains at your disposal as long as needed for your meetings or leisure travels.
page_voyages.v2_desc: Train station, airport, or business trips: optimize your time in a luxurious setting. Our chauffeurs welcome you courteously and ensure your travels with strict punctuality.
page_voyages.v3_desc: Make a grand entrance at your gala evenings, weddings, or corporate events. Our V-Class vans offer the space and elegance needed to sublime your most important moments.
page_voyages.v4_desc: A specific request? Our mobile concierge service meets all your requirements. From a specific vintage champagne to local macarons, we shape the cabin to your desires.
page_voyages.v5_desc: Enhance your wedding or special events with our exceptional vehicles. Flawless service to make your day unforgettable.
page_voyages.v6_desc: Our dedicated team meets all your requirements for a flawless Parisian stay. Restaurant bookings, hotels, and specific requests handled with the utmost discretion.

page_processus.title: The Process
page_processus.subtitle: From your first request to your destination, fluidity is our watchword.
page_processus.s1_desc: It all starts with you. Contact us to share your desires, dates, and the nature of your needs. We listen to understand every detail of your expectations.
page_processus.s2_desc: As soon as possible, our team submits a tailor-made itinerary and a clear quote. No standardized formulas: only proposals adjusted to your level of requirement.
page_processus.s3_desc: Let us guide you. Your expert chauffeur welcomes you with elegance and discretion. Your V-Class is perfectly prepared, air-conditioned, and equipped according to your preferences.
page_processus.s4_desc: Our relationship does not end at the destination. We ensure your complete satisfaction. It is this continuous attention that makes our clients return year after year.

page_excellence.title: SELY Privé Excellence
page_excellence.subtitle: The art of hosting, in motion.
page_excellence.intro: What makes us unique is not only found under the hood of our prestigious vehicles, but in the mindset that drives every member of our team. At SELY Privé, true luxury lies in anticipation, discreet refinement, and soft skills.
page_excellence.c1_desc: We understand the value of your private sphere. Our chauffeurs demonstrate total confidentiality during all your private and professional travels.
page_excellence.c2_desc: An unforeseen event? A last-minute change of plans? Our service adapts in real time to your requirements. You never adapt to us.
page_excellence.c3_desc: Rooted in the heart of Paris, we share our knowledge of the capital with you and open the doors to exceptional places often inaccessible.
page_excellence.c4_desc: Every detail matters. From the impeccable attire of our fleet to anticipating your needs, we aim for perfection with every mile.
page_excellence.why_desc: The best proof of our excellence lies in the loyalty of our clients. Over the years, SELY Privé has become the exclusive trusted partner of dozens of companies, prestigious hotels, and demanding individuals who rely solely on us for their stays in the region.
page_excellence.quote: Excellence is not an option, it is a requirement. Our mission is to transform every journey in Paris into a moment of absolute tranquility.
page_excellence.immersive_desc: Cross the City of Light in the absolute comfort of a moving palace.
page_excellence.onboard_1_desc: Climate-controlled Nappa leather seats designed to offer you optimal support and relaxation.
page_excellence.onboard_2_desc: Control ambient lighting, temperature, and sound environment at your fingertips.
page_excellence.onboard_3_desc: Perfect soundproofing isolates you from the Parisian hustle so you can focus on what matters.
page_excellence.test_1_quote: SELY Privé is the exclusive partner of our establishment. Our most demanding clients always praise the punctuality and professionalism of their chauffeurs.
page_excellence.test_2_quote: As a CEO, my schedule is timed to the minute. Knowing I can count on a comfortable vehicle and a discreet chauffeur to prepare for my meetings is invaluable.
page_excellence.test_3_quote: For the organization of our VIP events, the SELY Privé fleet adds the final touch of prestige. Always an impeccable service.

page_testimonials.title: Testimonials
page_testimonials.subtitle: Those who speak best of our service are those who have experienced it.
page_testimonials.t4_quote: The SELY Privé team took care of our guests for our wedding. The organization was flawless and the standing perfectly met our expectations.
page_testimonials.t5_quote: An incredible mobile concierge service. We had specific requests for hard-to-find wines and everything was ready upon our arrival.
page_testimonials.t6_quote: The best chauffeur service I have experienced in France. The chauffeur's knowledge of the region made our stay memorable.

page_privacy.title: Privacy Policy
page_privacy.subtitle: Your data, our commitment (GDPR Compliant)
page_privacy.s1_desc: The data controller for the personal data collected on this website is SELY. For any questions regarding your data, you can contact us at the email address: direction@sely.pro.
page_privacy.s2_desc: We only collect the information necessary to process your quote or booking requests: last name, first name, phone number, email address, and the logistical details of your journey.
page_privacy.s3_desc: The purpose of processing your data is to organize our transportation services and billing. The legal basis for this processing is the performance of the service contract between us or the implementation of pre-contractual measures (quotes).
page_privacy.s4_desc: Your data is strictly confidential. It is used exclusively internally by the SELY team and is never sold or transferred to third parties. It may only be shared with our technical service providers (web host, secure payment service) strictly for the purpose of carrying out the service.
page_privacy.s5_desc: Your data is kept for the time necessary for its processing purpose: 3 years after our last contact for prospecting/quote data, and 10 years for billing data (legal accounting obligation).
page_privacy.s6_desc: We implement all necessary technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
page_privacy.s7_desc: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete, limit, oppose, and port your data. To exercise your rights, please contact us by email. If you believe that your rights are not being respected, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (the French data protection authority, www.cnil.fr).
page_privacy.s8_desc: Our website is limited to the use of technical cookies strictly necessary for its proper functioning and your navigation. These cookies do not require prior consent.
